title: GTA 6 Was Originally Meant to Release Much Sooner
description: Rockstar Games has revealed that GTA 6 was originally intended to be developed alongside Red Dead Redemption 2, meaning it could have released much earlier.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Was Originally Meant to Release Much Sooner Than We Realized

The development history of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) has always been a subject of intense speculation among the global gaming community. Recently, according to a report by IGN, Rockstar Games has revealed a fascinating behind-the-scenes detail regarding the game's initial planning: the studio originally intended to develop GTA 6 alongside Red Dead Redemption 2.

This disclosure provides a fresh perspective on how one of the industry's premier developers manages its massive blockbuster franchises. For years, industry watchers assumed that Rockstar followed a sequential development model, pouring the collective efforts of its global studios into one colossal project before moving on to the next. Had this initial parallel development plan been fully realized, GTA 6 likely would have arrived much sooner than anyone anticipated.

### Analyzing the Development Strategy

Looking back at Rockstar's release timeline, *Red Dead Redemption 2* launched in 2018 to critical acclaim and massive commercial success. It was only after this monumental release that the studio shifted its primary focus toward the next iteration of the modern open-world crime epic. If the team had truly pushed forward with developing both giants at the same time, the production cycle for the new Vice City adventure would have commenced years earlier.

However, large-scale game development is fraught with complex challenges. Managing two projects of such unprecedented scope simultaneously would test the limits of any studio's resources, technical pipeline, and personnel management. It is reasonable to analyze that Rockstar ultimately adjusted its strategy to prioritize quality and avoid catastrophic crunch or resource division, which ultimately extended the wait time for fans.

### Looking Ahead

Even though the original timeline did not result in an earlier release, this insight highlights the ambitious scope with which Rockstar approaches its franchises. As more details and official information continue to surface, the anticipation for GTA 6 remains at an all-time high.

## Editor's Take

It is mind-boggling to think about the sheer scale of Rockstar's initial ambition to develop GTA 6 alongside Red Dead Redemption 2. While shifting priorities undoubtedly pushed back the eventual release window, it underscores the studio's commitment to delivering polished masterpieces. Good things take time, and this revelation only deepens the intrigue surrounding the most anticipated game in history.
